name: United States and Canada
comment: Not a pack: a fixture (#210). `cd packbuilder && uv run packbuilder set ../BirdJournal/BirdJournalKit/Tests/AlbumTests/Fixtures/united-states-and-canada` writes set.json beside this file with the country boundary the North America set will carry, which the Album package's placement test and the builder's tests/test_sets.py read. Only the set section and the species matter; the place ids and the bounding box are placeholders, and nothing is built or painted from it. Rerun the command after changing the boundary's constants in packbuilder/src/packbuilder/countries.py.
